# Layer add records a committed edit as a new layer on disk.

# Use SHA-1 to match the expected patch and project through the predecessor.
env GIT_DEFAULT_HASH=sha1
mkdir definition/layers
mv give/layer definition/layers/0001-base
cd definition
git init -q -b main
exec layerctl projection create edit --through 0001-base --worktree $WORK/edit

# Modify an existing file so the new layer records the change as a patch.
cp $WORK/give/edited.txt $WORK/edit/file.txt
git -C $WORK/edit commit -qam 'Edit file'

exec layerctl layer add --from edit 0002-edit
cmp layers/0002-edit/layer.toml $WORK/want/layer/layer.toml
cmp layers/0002-edit/patch $WORK/want/layer/patch

-- give/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = "Add file"

[[operation]]
[operation.overlay]
directory = "overlay"
-- give/layer/overlay/file.txt --
original
-- give/edited.txt --
edited
-- want/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = """
Edit file
"""

[[operation]]
[operation.patch]
file = "patch"
-- want/layer/patch --
diff --git a/file.txt b/file.txt
index 4b48deed3a433909bfd6b6ab3d4b91348b6af464..7663aa741bec2b1328630882586fb7a2cbc8a255 100644
--- a/file.txt
+++ b/file.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-original
+edited
